row: 澎湖群島位於臺灣海峽，是中新世火山活動留下的玄武岩方山島嶼。桶盤嶼、鳥嶼與西嶼大菓葉都有成排的柱狀玄武岩；小白沙嶼、雞善嶼與錠鉤嶼在 1992 年公告為澎湖玄武岩自然保留區，夏天有燕鷗在崖壁上築巢。

airspace.en: No site-specific notice was found for this area; before any real flight, check the CAA "Drone Map" app and apply as required.

islands.note: archipelago in the Taiwan Strait (Wikidata Q918799)

reserve.zh: 澎湖玄武岩自然保留區

jishan.note: two islets joined at low tide; hexagonal columns

dinggou.note: islet named for its anchor shape

xiaobaisha.note: curved columns, wave-cut platform and a white sand spit

niaoyu.note: basalt sea cliffs from the east to the north shore

kuibi.note: gravel path to Chiyu islet appears at low tide

limekiln.note: lime kiln of 1960 built of basalt and mortar

tongpan.note: basalt mesa ringed by columnar cliffs; geopark since 2008

fenggui.note: sea cave at the end of the Fenggui peninsula

shetou.note: site of the Dutch fort of 1622

tianhou.note: Taiwan's earliest Mazu temple, a national monument

shuncheng.note: gate of the Magong city wall

westfort.note: battery built by Liu Mingchuan after the Sino-French War

lighthouse.note: lighthouse on the south-west heights of Xiyu

daguoye.note: basalt cliff behind Daguoye fishing harbour (Wikidata Q90018638, the harbour)

title.en: A Stronghold in the Middle of the Strait

tagline.zh-Hant: 元朝的巡檢司、荷蘭人的城堡與清法戰爭的砲臺
tagline.en: A Yuan inspection office, a Dutch fort and the batteries of the Sino-French War

zh: 澎湖群島在臺灣海峽中，
距離臺灣本島約五十公里。
en: The Penghu Islands lie in the Taiwan Strait,
about 50 kilometres from Taiwan's main island.

zh: 群島總面積141平方公里，
是臺灣面積最小的縣。
en: The archipelago covers 141 square kilometres,
making it Taiwan's smallest county.

zh: 1281年，元朝在澎湖設立巡檢司，
比臺灣納入版圖早了403年。
en: In 1281 the Yuan dynasty set up an inspection office in Penghu,
403 years before Taiwan itself was incorporated.

zh: 澎湖天后宮是全臺灣最早建立的媽祖廟，
現在是國定古蹟。
en: Penghu Tianhou Temple is the earliest Mazu temple in Taiwan
and is now a national monument.

zh: 1622年，荷蘭人占領澎湖，
在蛇頭山上蓋了全臺第一座西式城堡。
en: In 1622 the Dutch occupied Penghu
and built Taiwan's first Western-style fort on Shetou Hill.

zh: 1624年，明朝派出四五十艘戰船與五千名士兵，
把荷蘭人逐出澎湖。
en: In 1624 a Ming fleet of 40 to 50 warships and 5,000 troops
drove the Dutch out of Penghu.

zh: 1683年7月12日，清軍在澎湖海戰初期
先拿下了桶盤嶼。
en: On 12 July 1683, early in the Battle of Penghu,
Qing forces took Tongpan Island.

zh: 這一戰擊敗了鄭氏的軍隊，
澎湖成為臺灣府轄下的一個廳。
en: The battle defeated the Zheng forces,
and Penghu became a sub-prefecture of Taiwan Prefecture.

zh: 1885年3月，法軍在清法戰爭中攻下澎湖；
西嶼東臺當時還沒裝上新式大砲。
en: In March 1885 the French took Penghu in the Sino-French War;
the East Fort on Xiyu had not yet received its modern guns.

zh: 戰後，劉銘傳在西嶼的內垵與外垵之間
修築了西臺。
en: After the war, Liu Mingchuan built the West Fort
on the high ground between Nei'an and Wai'an on Xiyu.

zh: 同樣在戰後興建的媽宮城，
是臺灣最晚由官方興建的城池。
en: The walled town of Magong, also built after the war,
was the last official city wall raised in Taiwan.

zh: 漁翁島燈塔，
在西嶼西南端的高地上。
en: The Yuwengdao Lighthouse
stands on the heights at the south-west end of Xiyu.

zh: 1970年，跨海大橋通車，
把白沙與西嶼連了起來。
en: In 1970 the Great Bridge opened,
joining Baisha and Xiyu.

zh: 元、明、荷蘭、清與法國的軍隊，
都在這片群島留下了據點。
en: Yuan, Ming, Dutch, Qing and French forces
all left strongholds on these islands.

tagline.zh-Hant: 菜宅、古榕、灰窯與一座橋
tagline.en: Walled gardens, an old banyan, a lime kiln and a bridge

zh: 小門嶼在西嶼北端，
面積只有0.5平方公里。
en: Xiaomen Islet lies at the north end of Xiyu
and covers only half a square kilometre.

zh: 島上的「菜宅」用石牆擋風，
保護牆內的作物。
en: Its "vegetable houses" use stone walls to break the wind
and shelter the crops inside.

zh: 步道邊還看得到石敢當，
當地人用它來鎮煞。
en: Beside the path stand shigandang stones,
set up by villagers to ward off harm.

zh: 往東是跨海大橋，
全長2,494公尺。
en: To the east is the Great Bridge,
2,494 metres long.

zh: 大橋橫跨吼門水道，
完工當時是遠東最長的跨海大橋。
en: It crosses the Houmen Channel;
when finished it was the longest sea bridge in the Far East.

zh: 最初的橋寬只有5.1公尺，
重建後在1996年以雙線通車。
en: The first bridge was only 5.1 metres wide;
rebuilt, it reopened with two lanes in 1996.

zh: 橋頭通梁村的古榕超過三百年，
有九十五根氣根。
en: The banyan of Tongliang village by the bridge is more than 300 years old
and has 95 aerial roots.

zh: 澎湖七成以上的居民，
祖先來自福建同安。
en: More than 72 per cent of Penghu's people
descend from settlers from Tong'an in Fujian.

zh: 漁業一直是這裡最主要的產業。
en: Fishing has always been the main industry here.

zh: 東邊的菓葉海岸，
有一座像城堡的灰白色建築。
en: On the Guoye shore to the east
stands a grey-white building like a small castle.

zh: 菓葉灰窯是1960年民眾自己蓋的石灰窯，
牆用玄武岩加灰漿砌成。
en: The Guoye Lime Kiln was built by local people in 1960,
its walls of basalt laid in mortar.

zh: 桶盤嶼2018年有378位居民，
每天有兩班交通船往返本島。
en: Tongpan Island had 378 residents in 2018,
with a ferry to the main island twice a day.

zh: 西嶼西南端的漁翁島燈塔，
屬於外垵村。
en: The Yuwengdao Lighthouse at the south-west end of Xiyu
belongs to Wai'an village.

zh: 2018年，有一百八十萬名遊客來到澎湖。
en: In 2018 1.8 million tourists visited Penghu.

title.en: Terns, Sandbars and the Shore between Tides

tagline.zh-Hant: 三座無人島的保留區，與風、雨都少的群島
tagline.en: A reserve of three uninhabited islets in an archipelago short of rain

zh: 澎湖本島東北方海上，
有三座受保護的小島。
en: Out at sea north-east of the main island
are three protected islets.

zh: 小白沙嶼、雞善嶼與錠鉤嶼，
在1992年3月12日公告為自然保留區。
en: Xiaobaisha, Jishan and Dinggou
were proclaimed a nature reserve on 12 March 1992.

zh: 保留區滿潮時19.13公頃，
低潮時30.87公頃。
en: The reserve measures 19.13 hectares at high tide
and 30.87 at low tide.

zh: 在這之前，軍方曾經用這些島做砲擊演習。
en: Before that, the armed forces used these islets for artillery practice.

zh: 夏天，蒼燕鷗、白眉燕鷗與岩鷺來到島上。
en: In summer, black-naped terns, bridled terns and reef egrets come to the islets.

zh: 牠們在玄武岩的崖壁上築巢，
通常八、九月離開。
en: They nest on the basalt cliffs
and usually leave by August or September.

zh: 過去，漁民與遊客
曾經上島撿拾鳥蛋。
en: In the past, fishermen and visitors
collected birds' eggs here.

zh: 澎湖年均溫約22.3度，
年雨量只有一千公釐左右。
en: Penghu averages about 22.3°C over the year
and receives only about 1,000 millimetres of rain.

zh: 北寮奎壁山外，退潮時會露出
一條長約三百公尺的S形礫石步道。
en: Off Kuibishan at Beiliao, the ebb tide uncovers
an S-shaped gravel path about 300 metres long.

zh: 青螺濕地有岩礁、礫石、沙灘、泥灘、
紅樹林與潮池，是澎湖濕地的縮影。
en: Qingluo Wetland has reef, gravel, sand, mud,
mangrove and tide pools: Penghu's wetlands in miniature.

zh: 澎澎灘原本是海流堆出的沙洲，
1986年韋恩颱風之後，滿潮也不再被淹沒。
en: Pengpeng Beach began as a sandbar piled up by currents;
after Typhoon Wayne in 1986 it stayed above even the high tide.

zh: 它的沙來自吉貝、鳥嶼與員貝嶼。
en: Its sand came from Jibei, Niaoyu and Yuanbei.

zh: 桶盤嶼附近有珊瑚礁，
浮潛就看得到。
en: Coral reefs lie close to Tongpan Island,
near enough to see by snorkelling.

zh: 沒有人住的三座小島，
現在留給海鳥。
en: Three islets where no one lives
are now left to the seabirds.

title.zh-Hant: 玄武岩的柱子與平頂的島
title.en: Columns of Basalt and Flat-Topped Islands

tagline.zh-Hant: 熔岩怎麼變成一根根石柱
tagline.en: How lava became row upon row of stone columns

zh: 桶盤嶼是一座玄武岩方山，
整圈海岸都是柱狀玄武岩的海崖。
en: Tongpan Island is a basalt mesa,
its whole shoreline a cliff of basalt columns.

zh: 這座島面積約0.34平方公里，
2008年1月成立地質公園。
en: The island covers about 0.34 square kilometres;
a geology park was established here in January 2008.

zh: 西南岸有階梯狀凹地「蓮花臺」，
還有蜂巢狀的「貓公石」。
en: On the south-west shore is the stepped basin called Lotus Terrace,
and the honeycombed Cat Rock.

zh: 澎湖是中新世盾狀火山的殘餘，
有二到四層玄武岩，夾著砂岩與泥岩。
en: Penghu is the remnant of a Miocene shield volcano:
two to four layers of basalt with sandstone and mudstone between.

zh: 熔岩冷卻收縮，
就裂成六角形或多角形的直立石柱。
en: As lava cooled and shrank,
it split into upright columns with six or more sides.

zh: 西嶼的大菓葉，是日治時期為了交通開挖，
才露出來的一片柱狀玄武岩。
en: At Daguoye on Xiyu, a wall of columnar basalt
was exposed by excavation for transport in the Japanese era.

zh: 西嶼面積約17.8平方公里，
海拔只有52公尺左右。
en: Xiyu covers about 17.8 square kilometres
and rises only some 52 metres above the sea.

zh: 小門嶼的鯨魚洞，
是海浪侵蝕出來的海蝕拱門。
en: Whale Cave on Xiaomen Islet
is a sea arch cut by the waves.

zh: 往東飛到鳥嶼：
玄武岩柱從東岸一直延伸到北岸。
en: East to Niaoyu,
where basalt columns run from the east shore round to the north.

zh: 崖下的海蝕平臺看得到放射狀的節理，
風化後像一層層洋蔥。
en: On the wave-cut platform below, the joints fan out like rays,
weathering into onion-like shells.

zh: 小白沙嶼的石柱是彎的；
北邊的海蝕平臺被切成豆腐狀。
en: On Xiaobaisha the columns are curved,
and the wave-cut platform to the north is diced like bean curd.

zh: 雞善嶼分成大小兩島，退潮時相連；
六角石柱直接從海床立起。
en: Jishan is two islets joined at low tide;
its six-sided columns rise straight from the sea bed.

zh: 錠鉤嶼的石柱朝著不同方向；
「錠鉤」就是船錨。
en: On Dinggou the columns point in many directions;
the name means a ship's anchor.

zh: 一千多萬年的日曬、雨淋與風，
把熔岩修成今天平頂的群島。
en: More than ten million years of sun, rain and wind
have shaped the lava into the flat-topped islands of today.
